newsitem.title: HUNGARY: ING Barings sees BUX at 6,700 points by year-end.
newsitem.headline: ING Barings sees BUX at 6,700 points by year-end.

text.p: ING Barings said it forecast the BUX index of the Budapest Stock Exchange to increase to 6,700 points by the end of the year and to 9,000 points by the end of 1998.
On Friday the BUX finished at 6,460.13 points.
In its June monthly report ING Barings said it estimated a total cash call over the second half of the year in excess of $700 million to $800 million on the market.
Privatisations are expected to add some liquidity to the tight Hungarian bourse.
ING Barings said it expected some short-term strength on the market from potential acquisitions and the possibility of a higher-than-expected energy price rise on July 1.
However, analysts Gabor Sitanyi and Gergely Varkonyi said, they expected some downward correction in July because of a lack of corporate news and more investment opportunities in Poland.
Hungary's Industry and Trade Ministry is due to decide today on the quarterly energy price increase.
